forecast_layer: a forecast is an OUTPUT scored at its issuer's record (naming-collapse registry convention) — calendar anchors are DATA ON THE SUBJECT, not a new participant class
publishability_flags: record_of_record text for AMD-20 cites an internal seat short-id (840bd147) — settlement-critical text, carried verbatim; flagged to main before render
expectation priors/posteriors are null/NOT_ESTABLISHED at open — render as no-estimate, never as 0
no winprob values exist anywhere in the book or this feed (B5 boundary holds)
ledger bookkeeping-event notes (internal routing language) are NOT carried in this feed — only positions/settlements arrays render

ledger_ref.note: ops/agentic-gambling/book/ledger.jsonl — append-only, PRIVATE record of record. This feed is a read-only render extract at ledger truth; it does not move the ledger.

publication: Public view of the internal book (owner ruling 2026-11-02). Entries stay internal: observational stakes only, no external participation surface, no wallet movement. Published values equal the ledger of record by construction.

sources.ledger: ops/agentic-gambling/book/ledger.jsonl (append-only ledger of record, MoneyBall plane)
sources.register: deadline-reminders/v1 (Tracking lane d6c12f3a; primary calendar, America/Los_Angeles) - anchors as bound in the book; derivation confirmed by Tracking 2026-11-02

honesty: Subjects with a rule knowable (NOT_ESTABLISHED / on receipt / at exam pass) render open-ended: no date is invented.
AMD-17 / AMD-18 carry no register anchors (NOT_ESTABLISHED in the book) - no landing/wall markers render.
Forecast is an OUTPUT class (naming-collapse amendment #3830): forecasts score at each subject's settlement, at the issuer's record. There are no forecast rows.
Date-only knowables render at end of day PT, except 'by wall' subjects, which resolve at the wall instant.
An expectation whose prior and posterior are both null is in INTAKE state and renders as INTAKE (no estimate) - never as a number, never as 0.

Window consumption (% remaining) is computed from each subject's window anchors at feed build (pct_block computed_at) and shades the window span of its bar; degenerate windows (wall at or before start - instant subjects) carry no percentage: never 0, never 100 by default.

The ledger's bookkeeping-event notes are internal routing language and do not render (MoneyBall publishability flag 4); the ledger is carried by reference - path + entry count - and only its positions/settlements extracts render.

pct_block.rule: pct_consumed/pct_remaining computed at feed build from window anchors; stamped per subject; never hand-entered; degenerate windows carry null + pct_note
pct_block.method: recomputed by this generator from the window anchors at build time; the upstream feed's stamped pct is proof-of-shape only

positions.gambler: owner (house stake, placed via the D2 entry operation)

stake.instrument: Vultr credit $200.00, applied 2026-11-03, expires ~2026-12-03 (use-it-or-lose-it; no cash at risk)
stake.deployment_rule: the position is taken by SPENDING the credit: every $ of burn (instances + inference, at plans-API rates) is stake deployed on the D2 entry's win expectation; unspent credit at expiry = stake never placed — a NEUTRAL state, not a loss (owner refinement 2026-11-03)
stake.metering: quota wiring provider row vultr {entitlement 200.00 · burn legs instances + inference}; D2 seat supplies daily credit ground-truth in build week

positions.basis: owner framing direct to the D2 seat 2026-11-03 (the use of the Vultr credits is itself a wager on the win, placed with house credits) + D2 entry records D2-3/D2-4/D2-5 in this book
positions.precondition: D2-4-submission-landed; resolution source of record = D2 submission confirmation_ref on lablab + official results

payout.structure: FIXED — burn does not raise the win amount by a cent (owner refinement 2026-11-03)
payout.subject_tier: top-3 placement per D2-5; amounts per the tiers of record

positions.dilution_note: stake rises against a FIXED payout => the position dilutes as burn grows: rational spend stops where marginal delta-p(win) per $ approaches 0; past that point extra burn wagers more for the identical return. Allocations argue their marginal delta-p, never their total spend.
positions.amended: 2026-11-03 (owner addendum via D2 seat: expiring-stake x fixed-payout equilibrium + demo-uptime reserve)

equilibrium.model: expiring stake AND fixed payout — two edges, both real (owner addendum 2026-11-03)
equilibrium.expiry_edge: expiry kills salvage value: unspent credit is worth $0 on Dec 4, so hoarding buys nothing
equilibrium.fixed_payout_edge: fixed payout caps the return: spend past marginal delta-p ~ 0 still dilutes (per the dilution note)
equilibrium.equilibrium: deploy credit wherever it buys delta-p(win) > 0 inside the window

reserved_slice.purpose: demo-uptime through judging — the ONLY reserved slice with standing value
reserved_slice.window: demo VM from Nov 8 to credit death ~Dec 3 (~25 days)
reserved_slice.priority: outranks discretionary burn — a dead demo during judging is a delta-p cliff
